formal_statement:
∃ C : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit, ∃ o : Fin 3 → Fin 3 → ℕ,
    PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.FanInTwo C ∧
    (∀ i j : Fin C.gates.length, (C.gates.get i).op = PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.GateOp.not →
      (C.gates.get j).op = PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.GateOp.not → i = j) ∧
    C.size ≤ 18 ∧
    (C.size = 18 → ∃ i : Fin C.gates.length, (C.gates.get i).op = PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.GateOp.not) ∧
    ∀ x : Fin 9 → Bool, ∀ a b : Fin 3,
      ((C.wires (List.ofFn x)).getD (o a b) false = true ↔
        ∃ c : Fin 3, ∃ k : Fin 9, (k : ℕ) = 3 * (c : ℕ) + ((a * c + b : Fin 3) : ℕ) ∧ x k = true)
plain_statement: Inputs x_(c,y) for c, y in Z_3, input number 3c + y. Outputs f_(a,b) = OR over c in Z_3 of x_(c, ac+b mod 3), for all nine (a,b). Circuits of AND, OR, NOT gates of fan-in at most two, any wire may be an output, at most one NOT gate, NOT not counted. Some such circuit with at most 17 AND/OR gates computes all nine outputs on all 512 inputs.
title: Nine affine-line ORs over Z_3: some fan-in-two circuit with at most 17 AND/OR gates and at most one NOT gate computes all nine
